translated: I'll always love ProSeka and all the songs.
Aww, wow.
Yeah, that's so sweet. But wait...
Using a computer provided by the school?
Yeah, that's what caught my eye first.
Right?
They actually give out computers now?
Do they really?
I've heard of tablets, but do they really hand out full computers?
That's a first for me.
Wow, I can't keep up with the times.
Since she's a JK, she's a high schooler, right?
I believe so.
Honestly, doing Sekaraji lets us hear about what's... how do I put it?
It lets us hear about what's trendy and what schools are like these days.
I wonder if they even have textbooks anymore.
Oh, maybe it's all on tablets now?
I wonder.
It's probably headed that way.
I totally get it, though.
Back in the day, I...
I lost a textbook for one of my subjects and had to keep borrowing one from another class.
If tablets can prevent that, they're definitely better.
True.
There were times when they'd insist we take everything home.
It was so heavy!
I used to just leave mine at school, even if they threatened to confiscate them.
We used to call that "okiben."
Yeah, we called it "okiben" too.
I guess you don't have to worry about that with a tablet.
